Concert information

Maxime Pascal makes his debut with Berlioz’s “L’Enfance du Christ”

Tickets

17. Dec 26, 20:00 18. Dec 26, 20:00 19. Dec 26, 19:00

Info

A Christmas oratorio in the French style. In L’Enfance du Christ, Hector Berlioz tells the story of events following the birth of Jesus: the visit of the Three Wise Men to the cruel King Herod, and the flight of the Holy Family to Egypt, where they finally find refuge. Berlioz’s music combines operatic drama with quiet devotion, radiant orchestral colours with magnificent choral writing. The work brought the composer great acclaim. With this performance, Maxime Pascal – one of the musical directors of the Deutsche Oper Berlin – makes his debut with the Berliner Philharmoniker.

Artists

Berliner Philharmoniker
Maxime Pascal conductor
Julie Boulianne mezzo-soprano (Sainte Marie)
Allan Clayton tenor (Un récitant)
Huw Montague Rendall baritone (Saint Joseph)
Jean Teitgen bass (Hérode)
Edwin Crossley-Mercer baritone (Un père de famille)
Theodore Platt baritone (Polydorus)
Caspar Singh tenor (Un centurion)
Rundfunkchor Berlin

Programme

Hector Berlioz
L'Enfance du Christ, Oratorio, op. 25

Additional information

Duration ca. 1 hour and 45 minutes
